activity_summary: Alone, you kept the wide stage, the hush, and the clear note. You did not write two thousand down as money, and you did not make a picture of the nuts.

facets.activity: Named the house and the song

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Two thousand is a house. It is not a sum I am writing down.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Sam sang, and the note was clear.
